description: This file is a header file (`lapi.h`) for the Lua C API, defining macros and including other internal Lua headers to facilitate API functions related to stack management, error checking, and return value handling.

methods.name: api_incr_top
methods.description: Macro to increment the top of the Lua stack and check for overflow.

methods.name: adjustresults
methods.description: Macro to adjust the top of the call info stack based on the number of results.

methods.name: api_checknelems
methods.description: Macro to ensure there are enough elements in the stack for a function call.

methods.name: hastocloseCfunc
methods.description: Macro to determine if a C function has variables that need to be closed.

methods.name: codeNresults
methods.description: Macro to encode the number of results into an internal representation.

methods.name: decodeNresults
methods.description: Macro to decode the internal representation back into the number of results.
